title: Mapping-space excision for a simplicial indexing pushout
statement:
Use simplicial sets, quasicategories, coherent functor categories and right-pinched mapping spaces as defined in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], with all objects small in a sufficiently large fixed universe. Let $i:A\to D$ and $j:A\to B$ be maps of simplicial sets, with $i$ degreewise injective, and put $K=B\amalg_A D$. For any quasicategory $\mathcal C$ and any two diagrams $F,G:K\to\mathcal C$, restriction induces an equivalence of spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C)}(F,G)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B,\mathcal C)}(F|_B,G|_B)\mathop{\times}^{h}_{\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(A,\mathcal C)}(F|_A,G|_A)}\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(D,\mathcal C)}(F|_D,G|_D).$$
Here, for maps $u:U\to W$ and $v:V\to W$ of Kan complexes, $U\times_W^h V$ is the space of triples $(a,b,\gamma)$, where $a\in U$, $b\in V$, and $\gamma$ is a path in $W$ from $u(a)$ to $v(b)$, with all higher simplices of these data; a model is $U\times_{W,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,W)\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,W}V$. The comparison sends a transformation to its two restrictions and the constant path between their identical restrictions to $A$. It is natural in both diagrams and compatible, up to coherent homotopy, with precomposition and postcomposition of transformations. No existence of limits or colimits in $\mathcal C$ is assumed.
